props.text: RAID ROSTER. Bring a healer. Bring two. Sign below. (Somebody has signed 'Sir Wadsworth' in a very wobbly hand, with a heron's footprint.)

regions.name: Lantern Stair
regions.text: The Hollow Heart. Under Mirefen the old spirit grove still breathes, slowly and wrong. Someone has pitched a tent by the stair and is counting things in a ledger.

regions.name: Root Gallery
regions.text: The Root Gallery. Roots as thick as houses hold up the dark. The ones nearest the den have gone grey to the tip.

regions.name: Thornmaw's Den
regions.text: Thornmaw's Den. Something sleeps here in a nest of thorns and old bones. It sleeps lightly.
Black thorns choke the way north. They twitch in time with something huge breathing in the den.

regions.name: Weeping Pools
regions.text: The Weeping Pools. Every drop that falls here falls as a tear, and the pools are very full.

regions.successText: Behind a veil of thorns in the corner, candle-stubs glint: somebody hid the grove's offerings here, a long time ago.

regions.name: Mire Hollow
regions.text: Mire Hollow. The fen has seeped down into the grove, and someone has made a kitchen of it. It smells of nettle soup and bad intentions.

regions.name: Heart Chamber
regions.text: The Heart Chamber. The old heart lantern of the grove sits in a cage of roots, and something in it beats. Boom. ...boom.
